messages:
elaine: Draft SOW for field upgrades and launch criteria attached. TL;DR — we need clear customer pre-reqs, a minimal acceptance test suite, and explicit rollback and handoff steps. Ping if you see gaps.

sam: Saw it, thanks. Quick q: are we committing to IP-preservation or just documenting best-effort?

kyle: We should offer IP preservation as a formal option for customers who require netops guarantees. That implies preserved-peering mode + an explicit rollback path. Implementation needs handshake for IP ranges and allocation windows. :thumbsup:

mira: Adding a quick ops checklist: DNS zones, BGP/peering creds, cert provisioning, KMS key handoff, and cross-account role docs. Do we want an "airgap" installer variant included in the SOW?

elaine: Yes — SOW will define three packaging tracks: 1) hosted edge connector (lightweight), 2) VPC-managed (peering/reserved IPs), and 3) airgap bundle (tarball + attestations). We expect most customers to land in track 2.

sam: For on-prem installer: what’s the minimum downtime commitment? Need to design rolling upgrade with canaries to avoid leader-election blips taking inference offline.

kyle: Target: <= 10m visible traffic disruption per tenant for rolling upgrades when images and configs are pre-staged. Airgap/offline patching will be longer — documented in the SOW. We’ll capture metrics to validate.

mira: Proposed acceptance tests (customer staging): basic inference smoke, KV cache sanity, TLS cert validation, model pinning check, and throughput within 20% of baseline. Also a latency check.

elaine: Make latency explicit: 99th percentile must be within +200ms of baseline for SLA-committed customers. Add automated test harness to run these.

sam: I'll add a Jenkins job + a small helper script: `./tools/deploy-smoke --env customer-xyz --tests basic,kvs,latency`. That will produce a simple pass/fail artifact and logs.

deploy-bot: CI: smoke test job started for env=customer-xyz (#4567). Logs: https://ci.redwood/4567

kyle: Rollback strategy notes: keep previous runtime images cached on nodes, allow `--force-rollback` in operator CLI, and provide a network rollback checklist (peering revert, IP re-assignment steps). Network rollback requires coordination with customer NetOps.

mira: Field handoff doc should include: contact matrix, escalation path (SRE -> NetOps -> Customer Success), quick demo script for customer verification, and a short sign-off checklist the customer signs in staging.

elaine: Proposed launch gates: (1) SOW signed, (2) pre-flight checklist cleared, (3) acceptance tests green in customer staging, (4) runbook + PagerDuty routing configured, (5) capacity & model pinning validated. Anything missing?

sam: Add capacity validation: reserved GPU count verified, quantization profile applied if used, and smoke test under load. Also confirm model version pinning and fallback model set.

kyle: Also require IPAM confirmation: customer's IP ranges reserved, NAT/egress plan documented, and transit/NVA requirements spelled out.

mira: I’ll draft the customer-facing checklist and a short handoff email template to send to NetOps and CS. ETA: end of day tomorrow.

elaine: Great. Action items: Sam -> smoke job + runbook; Kyle -> peering/rollback steps doc; Mira -> customer checklist + email template; Elaine -> finalize SOW edits and distribution. Sync tomorrow 11:00am PT. :calendar: 

sam: ack

kyle: ack

mira: on it
